title: Sweet Potato & Lentil Curry
description: Red lentils and diced sweet potato simmer in coconut milk with warming curry spices.
ingredients: 1 medium sweet potato, peeled and diced
instructions: Heat oil in a pot and cook onion 5 minutes until soft.
Add garlic, ginger and curry powder and stir 30 seconds.
Add sweet potato, lentils, coconut milk, water and salt; bring to a gentle boil.
Turn down heat and simmer, loosely covered, 20–25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until soft; add water if needed.
Finish with lime juice and cilantro.
